library.name: Three.js
library.description: WebXR / WebGL 3D library used to render the cyberspace scene.

library.name: Three.js addons (GLTFLoader, Draco, KTX2, meshopt, FBXLoader)
library.description: Three.js example modules and their decoders: the glTF loader with Draco, KTX2/Basis and meshopt support, plus the FBX loader (with its fflate and NURBS dependencies), used to load authored 3D asset packs in glTF or FBX form.

library.name: MediaPipe Tasks Vision (hand/face/pose landmarkers + models)
library.description: On-device hand, face and body-pose landmark detection (WASM runtime, ES module bundle and the hand, face and pose_landmarker_lite model files) powering the optional pose-based camera navigation for flat-screen viewers and the teacher presenter mode.

library.name: troika-three-text (with troika-three-utils, troika-worker-utils, bidi-js, webgl-sdf-generator)
library.description: SDF (signed distance field) text rendering for Three.js, used for the opt-in Ultra crisp-at-any-zoom sign lettering. Rolled up into a single ES module (modified: bundled with its dependencies, and three.js externalised to the plugin's bundled copy via a relative import so no page import map is needed).

library.name: Share Tech Mono
library.description: A monospace display font (Latin subset, WOFF) used by the SDF sign-text renderer. Unmodified upstream font file.
